1: Come, Agni, praised with song, to feast and sacrificial offering: sit As Hotar on the holy grass!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
O Agni, thou hast been ordained Hotar of every sacrifice, By Gods, among the race of men.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
Agni we choose as envoy, skilled performer of this holy rite, Hotar, possessor of all wealth.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Served with oblation, kindled, bright, through love of song may Agni, bent On riches, smite the Vritras dead!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
I laud your most beloved guest like a dear friend, O Agni, him Who, like a chariot, wins us wealth.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
Do thou, O Agni, with great might guard us from all malignity, Yea, from the hate of mortal man!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
O Agni, come; far other songs of praise will I sing forth to thee. Wax mighty with these Soma-drops!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
May Vatsa draw thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling place! Agni, I yearn for thee with song.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the sky, the head Of all who offer sacrifice.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
O Agni, bring us radiant light to be our mighty succour, for Thou art our visible deity!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength: With terrors trouble thou the foe
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
I seek with song your messenger, oblation-bearer, lord of wealth, Immortal, best at sacrifice.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Still turning to their aim in thee the sacrificer's sister hymns Have come to thee before the wind.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
To thee, illuminer of night, O Agni, day by day with prayer, Bringing thee reverence, we come.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Help, thou who knowest lauds, this work, a lovely hymn in Rudra's praise, Adorable in every house!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
To this fair sacrifice to drink the milky draught art thou called forth: O Agni, with the Maruts come!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
With homage will I reverence thee, Agni, like a long-tailed steed, Imperial lord of holy rites.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
As Aurva and as Bhrigu called, as Apnavana called, I call The radiant Agni robed with sea.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song: I kindle Agni till he glows.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
Then, verily, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed, Kindled on yonder side of heaven.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him who prospers you, Most frequent at our solemn rites.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
May Agni with his pointed blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend: May Agni win us wealth by war!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
Agni, be gracious; thou art great: thou hast approached the pious man, Hast come to sit on sacred grass.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
Agni, preserve us,from distress consume our enemies, O God, Eternal, with thy hottest flames
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Harness, O Agni, O thou God, thy steeds which are most excellent! The fleet ones bring thee rapidly.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Lord of the tribes, whom all must seek, we worshipped Agni set thee down, Refulgent, rich in valiant men.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Agni is head and height of heaven, the master of the earth is he He quickeneth the waters' seed.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
O Agni, graciously announce this our good fortune of the Gods, And this our newest hymn of praise!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
By song, O Agni, Angiras! Gopavana hath brought thee forth Hear thou my call, refulgent one!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
Agni, the Sage, the Lord of Strength, hath moved around the sacred gifts, Giving the offerer precious things.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
His heralds bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, The Sun, that all may look on him.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.11
Praise Agni in the sacrifice, the Sage whose holy laws are true The God who driveth grief away.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.12
Kind be the Goddesses to lend us help, and kind that we may drink: May their streams bring us health and wealth
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.13
Lord of the brave, whose songs dost thou in thine abundance now inspire, Thou whose hymns help to win the kine?
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.14
Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice for strength. Come, let us praise the wise and, everlasting God even as a well-beloved friend,
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
Agni, protect thou us by one, protect us by the second song, Protect us by three hymns, O Lord of power and might, bright God, by four hymns guard us well!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
O Agni, with thy lofty beams, with thy pure brilliancy, O God, Kindled, most youthful one! by Bharadvaja's hand, shine on us richly, holy Lord!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part, as gifts, the stall of kine!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
Agni, praise-singer! Lord of men, God! burning up the Rakshasas, Mighty art thou, the ever-present, household-lord! home-friend and guardian from the sky.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
Immortal Jatavedas, thou bright-hued refulgent gift of Dawn, Agni, this day to him who pays oblations bring the Gods who waken with the morn!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
Wonderful, with thy favouring help, send us thy bounties, gracious Lord. Thou art the charioteer, Agni, of earthly wealth: find rest and safety for our seed!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, preserver, righteous, and a Sage. The holy singers, O enkindled radiant one, ordainers, call on thee to come.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
O holy Agni, give us wealth famed among men and strengthening life! Bestow on us, O helper, that which many crave, more glorious still through righteousness!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
To him, who dealeth out all wealth, the sweet-toned Hotar-priest of men, To him like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni let the lauds go forth.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
With this mine homage I invoke Agni for you, the Son of Strength, Dear, wisest envoy, skilled in noble sacrifice, immortal messenger of all.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Thou liest in the logs that are thy mothers: mortals kindle thee. Alert thou bearest off the sacrifleer's gift, and then thou shinest to the Gods.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
He hath appeared, best prosperer, in whom men lay their holy acts: So may our songs of praise come nigh to Agni who was born to give the Arya strength!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
Chief Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice. Gods! Maruts! Brahmanaspati! I crave with song the help that is most excellent.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Pray Agni of the piercing flame, with sacred songs, to be our help; For wealth, famed Agni, Purumilha and ye men! He is Suditi's sure defence.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods! With those who come at dawn let Mitra, Aryaman sit on the grass at sacrifice.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Agni of Divodasa, God, comes forth like Indra in his might. Rapidly hath he moved along his mother earth: he stands in high heaven's dwelling-place.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Whether thou come from earth or from the lofty lucid realm of heaven, Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most wise!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
If, loving well the forests, thou wentest to thy maternal floods, Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when, from afar, thou now art here.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
O Agni, Manu stablished thee a light for all the race of men: With Kanva hast thou blazed, Law-born and waxen strong, thou whom the people reverence.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.10
The God who giveth wealth accept your full libation poured to, him! Pour ye it out, then fill the vessel full again, for so the God regardeth you.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
Let Brahmanaspati come forth, let Sunrita the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which yields a fivefold gift the hero, lover of mankind!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
Stand up erect to lend us aid, stand up like Savitar the God, Erect as strength-bestower when we call on thee with priests who balm our offerings!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
The man who bringeth gifts to thee, bright God who fain wouldst lead to wealth, Winneth himself a brave son, Agni! skilled in lauds, one prospering in a thousand ways.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
With hymns and holy eulogies we supplicate your Agni, Lord Of many families who duly serve the Gods, yea, him whom others too inflame.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
This Agni is the Lord of great prosperity and hero, strength, Of wealth with noble offspring and with store of kine, the Lord of battles with the foe.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Thou, Agni, art the homestead's Lord, our Hotar-priest at sacrifice. Lord of all boons, thou art the Potar, passing wise. Pay worship, and enjoy the good!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
We as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help. The Waters' Child, the blessed, the most mighty one, swift conqueror, and without a peer.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Present oblations, make him splendid: set ye as Hotar in his place the Home's Lord, worshipped With gifts and homage where they pour libations! Honour him meet for reverence in our houses.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
Verily wondrous is the tender youngling's growth who never draweth nigh to drink his mother's milk. As soon as she who hath no udder bore him, he, faring on his. great errand, suddenly grew strong.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Here is one light for thee, another yonder: enter the third and, be therewith united. Beautiful be thy union with the body, beloved in the Gods' sublimest birthplace!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
For Jatavedas, worthy of our praise, will we frame with our mind this eulogy as 'twere a car; For good, in his assembly, is this care of ours. Let us not, in thy friendship, Agni, suffer harm!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Agni Vaisvanara, born in course of Order, the messenger of earth, the head of heaven, The Sage, the sovran, guest of men, our vessel fit for their mouth, the Gods have generated.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Even as the waters from the mountain ridges, so sprang the; Gods, through lauds, from thee, O Agni. To thee speed hymns and eulogies, as horses haste, bearing him who loves the song, to battle.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Win to protect you, Rudra, lord of worship, priest of both worlds, effectual sacrificer, Agni, invested with his golden colours, before the thunder strike and lay you senseless!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
The King whose face is decked with oil is kindled with homage offered by his faithful servant. The men, the priests adore him with oblations. Agni hath shone forth at the flush of morning.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Agni advanceth with his lofty banner: through earth and heaven the Bull hath loudly bellowed He hath come nigh from the sky's farthest limit: the Steer hath waxen in the waters' bosom.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
From the two fire-sticks have the men engendered with thoughts, urged by the hand, the glorious Agni, Far-seen, with pointed flame, Lord of the Homestead.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
Agni is wakened by the people's fuel to meet the Dawn who cometh like a milch-cow. Like young trees shooting up on high their branches, his flames. are mounting to the vault of heaven.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
Set forth the gleaming one, the song-inspirer, not foolish with. the foolish, fort- destroyer, Who leadeth with his hymns to thought of conquest, gold-bearded, richly splendid with his armour
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
Thou art like heaven: one form is bright, one holy, like Day and Night dissimilar in colour. All magic powers thou aidest, self-dependent! Auspicious bethy bounty here, O Pushan!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels! To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Stablished to fill the juice with vital vigour, giver of wealth, guard of his servant's body, The great Priest, born, who knows the clouds, abider with men, is seated in the waters' eddy.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Let the song, honouring the best, with longing honour the Asura's most famous sovran, The deeds of him the mighty, deeds like Indra's, the manly one in whom the folk must triumph!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
In the two kindling-blocks lies Jatavedas like the well-cherished germ in pregnant women,-- Agni who day by day must be entreated by men who watch provided with oblations.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
Agni, from days of old thou slayest demons: never shall Rakshasas in fight o'ercome thee. Burn up the foolish ones, raw flesh devourers: let none of them escape thine heavenly arrow!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Bring us most mighty splendour thou, Agni, resistless on thy way: Prepare for us the path that leads to glorious opulence and strength!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
May the brave man, if full of zeal he serve and kindle Agni's flame, Duly presenting sacred gifts, enjoy the Gods' protecting help.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
Thy bright smoke lifts itself aloft, and far-extended shines in heaven, For, Purifier! like the Sun thou beamest with thy radiant glow.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Thou, Agni, even as Mitra, hast a princely glory of thine own. Bright, active God, thou makest fame increase like means of nourishment.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
At dawn let Agni, much-beloved, guest of the house, be glorified, In whom, the everlasting one, all mortals make their offerings blaze.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
Most moving song be Agni's: shine on high, O rich in radiant light! Like the chief consort of a King riches and strength proceed from thee.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
Exerting all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech Agni your dear familiar friend, the darling guest in every house.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
His beam hath lofty power of life: sing praise to Agni, to the God Whom men have set in foremost place, like Mitra for their eulogy!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
To noblest Agni, friend of man, chief Vritra-slayer, have we come- Who with Srutarvan, Riksha's son, in lofty presence is inflamed.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
Born as the loftiest Law commands, comrade of those who grew with him. Agni, the sire of Kasyapa by faith, the mother, Manu, Sage.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
We in King Soma place our trust, in Agni, and in Varuna, The Aditya, Vishnu, Surya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Hence have these men gone up on high and mounted to the heights of heaven: On! conquer on the path by which Angirasas travelled to the skies!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
That thou mayst send us ample wealth, O Agni, we will kindler thee: So, for the great oblation, Steer, pray Heaven and Earth to come to us!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
He runs when one calls after him, This is the prayer of him who prays. He holds all knowledge in his grasp even as the felly rounds the wheel.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Shoot forth, O Agni, with thy flame: demolish them on every side! Break down the Yatudhana's strength, the vigour of the Rakshasa!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Worship the Vasus, Agni! here, the Rudras and Adityas, all Who know fair sacrifices, sprung from Mann, scattering blessings down!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
2: Agni, thy faithful servant I call upon thee with many a gift, As in the keeping of the great inciting God.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
To Agni, to the Hotar-priest offer your best, your lofty speech, To him ordainer-like who bears the light of songs.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
O Agni, thou who art the lord of wealth in kine, thou Son of Strength, Bestow on us, O Jatavedas, high renown
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Most skilled in sacrifice, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious, man: A joyful Priest, thy splendour drives our foes afar
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Taught by seven mothers at his birth was he, for glory of the wise. He, firm and sure, hath set his mind on glorious wealth
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
And in the day our prayer is this: May Aditi come nigh to help, With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Worship thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts, Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
No mortal man can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him Who hath served Agni well, the oblation-giving God.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Agni, drive thou the wicked foe, the evil-hearted thief away, Far, far, Lord of the brave! and give us easy paths!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
O hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine Burn down the Rakshasas, enchanters, with thy flame!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Sing forth to him the holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow, To Agni, ye Upastutas
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of valiant sons and does great deeds, Whose bond of friendship is thy choice
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Sing praise to him the Lord of light! The Gods have made the God to be their messenger, To bear oblation to the Gods.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
Anger not him who is our guest! He is the bright God Agni, praised by many a man, God Hotar, skilled in sacrifice.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
May Agni, worshipped, bring us bliss: may the gift, blessed one! and sacrifice bring bliss. Yea, may our eulogies bring bliss.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Thee have we chosen skilfullest in sacrifice, immortal Priest among the Gods, Wise finisher of this holy rite.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Bring us that splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode, And the malicious wrath of men!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manu's race Agni averteth from us all the Rakshasas!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Sing this, beside the flowing juice, to him your hero, much-invoked, To please him as a mighty Bull
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine Which is most glorious of all!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
Ye cows, protect the fount: the two mighty ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
Sing praises that the horse may come; sing, Srutakaksha, that the cow May come, that Indra's might may come
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
We make this Indra very strong to strike, the mighty Vritra dead: A vigorous hero shall he be.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Based upon strength and victory and power, O Indra, is thy birth: Thou, mighty one! art strong indeed,
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
The sacrifice made Indra great when he unrolled the earth, and made Himself a diadem in heaven.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
If I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single ruler over wealth My worshipper should be rich in kine.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Pressers, blend Soma juice for him, each draught most excellent, for him The brave, the hero, for his joy.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
Here is the Soma juice expressed. O Vasu, drink till thou art full: Undaunted God, we give it thee
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
Surya, thou mountest up to meet the hero famous for his wealth, Who hurls the bolt and works for man.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou, Surya hast risen upon to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
That Indra is our youthful friend, who with his trusty guidanceled Turvasa, Yadu from afar.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light This may we gain with thee for friend!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
Indra, bring wealth that gives delight, the victor's ever-conquering wealth, Most excellent, to be our aid
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
In mighty battle we invoke Indra, Indra is lesser fight, The friend who bends his bolt at fiends.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice There he displayed his manly might.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
Faithful to thee, we sing aloud, heroic Indra, songs to thee Mark, O good Lord, this act of ours!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway trim the sacred grass, Whose friend is Indra ever young.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around, And bring the wealth for which we long!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
I Hear, as though 'twere close at hand, the cracking of the whips they hold: They gather splendour on their way.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee As men with fodder to the herd.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men bow down, As rivers bow them to the sea.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
We choose unto ourselves that high protection of the mighty Gods, That it may help and succour us.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
O Brahmanaspati, make thou Kakshivan Ausija a loud Chanter of flowing Soma juice!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Much honoured with libations may the Vritra-slayer watch for us: May Sakra listen to our prayer
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Send us this day, God Savitar, prosperity with progeny Drive thou the evil dream away!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong-necked and never yet bent down? What Brahman ministers to him?
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
There where the mountains downward slope, there at the meeting of the streams The Sage was manifest by song.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
Praise Indra whom our songs must laud, sole sovran of mankind, the chief Most liberal who controlleth men
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.10
Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksha's draught, The Soma juice with barley brew.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
O Lord of ample wealth, these songs of praise have called aloud to thee, Like milch-kine lowing to their calves!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
Then straight they recognized the mystic name of the creative Steer, There in the mansion of the Moon.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
When Indra, strongest hero, brought the streams, the mighty waters down, Pushan was standing by his side.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
The Cow, the streaming mother of the liberal Maruts, pours her milk, Harnessed to draw their chariots on.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
Come, Lord of rapturous joys, to our libation with thy bay steeds, come With bay steeds to the flowing juice
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice, With night, unto the cleansing bath.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
I from my Father have received deep knowledge of eternal Law: I was born like unto the Sun.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
With Indra splendid feasts be ours, rich in all strengthening things, wherewith, Wealthy in food, we may rejoice
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
Soma and Pushan, kind to him who travels to the Gods, provide Dwellings all happy and secure.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Invite ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma steeds, juice, All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
Sing ye a song, to make him glad, to Indra, Lord of tawny The Soma-drinker, O my friends!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
This, even this, O Indra, we implore: as thy devoted friends The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
For Indra, lover of carouse, loud be our songs about the juice Let poets sing the song of praise.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Here, Indra, is thy Soma draught, made pure upon the sacred grass: Run hither, come and drink thereof
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
As a good cow to him who milks, we call the doer of good deeds To our assistance duy by day.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink Sate thee and finish thy carouse!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
The Soma, Indra, which is shed in saucers and in cups for thee, Drink thou, for thou art lord thereof!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
In every need, in every fray we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
O come ye hither, sit ye down: to Indra sing ye forth your song, Companions, bringing hymns of praise
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
So, Lord of affluent gifts, this juice hath been expressed for thee with strength: Drink of it, thou who lovest song!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
Great is our Indra from of old; greatness be his, the Thunderer Wide as the heaven extends his might.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
Indra, as one with mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand Manifold and nutritious spoil!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine, The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
With what help will he come to us, wonderful, ever-waxing friend? With what most mighty company?
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours Him who is drawn to all our songs.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
To the assembly's wondrous Lord, the lovely friend of Indra, I Had prayed for wisdom and successs.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
May all thy paths beneath the sky whereby thou speddest Vyasva on, Yea, let all spaces hear our voice
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength, For, Indra, thou art kind to us!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
Here is the Soma ready pressed: of this the Maruts, yea, of this, Self-luminous the Asvins drink.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
Tossing about, the active ones came nigh to Indra at his birth, Winning themselves heroic might.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
Never, O Gods, do we offend, nor are we ever obstinate We walk as holy texts command.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
Evening is come: sing loudly thou Atharvan's nobly singing son: Give praise to Savitar the God!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Now Morning with her earliest light shines forth, dear daughter of the Sky: High, Asvins, I extol your praise.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
Armed with the bones of dead Dadhyach, Indra, with unresisted might The nine-and-ninety Vritras slew.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all our Soma feasts, Protector, mighty in thy strength
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
O thou who slayest Vritras, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty one, with thy mighty aids!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
That might of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth,
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
This is thine own Thou drawest near, as turns a pigeon to his mate: Thou carest, too, for this our prayer.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
May Vata breathe his balm on us, healthful, delightful to our heart: May he prolong our days of life
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
Ne'er is he injured whom the Gods Varuna, Mitra, Aryam. The excellently wise, protect.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
According to our wish for kine, for steeds and chariots, as of old, Be gracious to our wealthy chiefs
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught, Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
That thou much-lauded! many-named! mayst, with this thought, that longs for milk, Come to each Soma sacrifice.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
May bright Sarasvati, endowed with plenteous wealth and spoil, enriched With prayer, desire the sacrifice.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Why 'mid the Nahusha tribes shall sate this Indra with his Soma juice? He shall bring precious things to us.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Come, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here: Sit thou on this my sacred grass
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Great, unassailable must be the heavenly favour of the Three, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
We, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our guide, depend on one like thee, Thou driver of the tawny steeds!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
3: Let Soma juices make thee glad! Display thy bounty, Thunderer: Drive off the enemies of prayer!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
Drink our libation, Lord of hymns! with streams of meath thou art bedewed: Yea, Indra, glory is thy gift.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
Indra hath ever thought of you and tended you with care. The God, Heroic Indra, is not checked.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea O Indra, naught excelleth thee!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Indra, the singers with high praise, Indra reciters with their lauds, Indra the choirs have glorified.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
May Indra give, to aid us wealth handy that rules the skilful ones! Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Verily Indra, conquering all, drives even mighty fear away, For firm is he and swift to act.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
These songs with every draught we pour come, lover of the song, to thee As milch-kine hasten to their calves.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Indra and Wishan will we call for friendship and prosperity, And for the winning of the spoil.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
O Indra, Vritra-slayer, naught is better, mightier than thou Verily there is none like thee!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Him have I magnified, our Lord in common, guardian of your folk, Discloser of great wealth in kine.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
Songs have outpoured themselves to thee, Indra, the strong, the guardian Lord, And with one will have risen to thee!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Good guidance hath the mortal man whom Arya-man, the Marut host, And Mitras, void of guile, protect.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
Bring us the wealth for which we long, O Indra, that which is concealed In strong firm place precipitous.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Him your best Vritra-slayer, him the famous champion of mankind I urge to great munificence.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Indra, may we adorn thy fame, fame of one like thee, hero! deck, Sakra! thy fame at highest feast!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Indra, accept at break of day our Soma mixt with roasted corn, With groats, with cake, with eulogies!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuchi, When thou o'ercamest all the foes.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Thine are these Soma juices, thine, Indra, those still to be expressed: Enjoy them, Lord of princely wealth!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
For thee, O Indra, Lord of light, Somas are pressed and grass is strewn: Be gracious to thy worshippers!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
We seeking strength, with Soma drops fill full your Indra like a well, Most liberal, Lord of boundless might.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
O Indra, even from that place come unto us with food that gives A hundred, yea, a thousand powers!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
The new-born Vritra-slayer asked his mother, as he seized his shaft, Who are the, fierce and famous ones?
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, the highly-lauded, who Fulfils the work to favour us
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Mitra who knoweth leadeth us, and Varuna who guideth straight, And Aryaman in accord with Gods.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
When, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away, She spreadeth light on every side.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Varuna, Mitra, sapient pair, pour fatness on our pastures, pour Meath on the regions of the air!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
And, at our sacrifices, these, sons, singers, have enlarged their bounds, So that the cows must walk knee-deep.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Through all this world strode Vishnu: thrice his foot he planted, and the whole Was gathered in his footstep's dust.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
Pass by the wrathful offerer; speed the man who pours libation, drink The juice which he presents to thee!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
What is the word addressed to him, God great and excellently wise? For this is what exalteth him.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
His wealth who hath no store of kine hath ne'er found out recited laud, Nor song of praises that is sung.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Lord of each thing that giveth strength, Indra delighteth most in lauds, Borne by bay steeds, libations' friend.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
With wealth to our libation come, be not thou angry with us, like A great man with a youthful bride.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
When, Vasu, wilt thou love the laud? Now let the Channel bring the stream. The juice is ready to ferment.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
After the Seasons. Indra, drink the Soma from the Brahman's gift: Thy friendship is invincible! S. O Indra, lover of the song, we are the singers of thy praise O Soma-drinker, quicken us!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
O Indra, in each fight and fray give to our bodies manly strength: Strong Lord, grant ever-conquering might!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
For so thou art the brave man's friend; a hero, too, art thou, and strong: So may thine heart be won to us!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
Like kine unmilked we call aloud, hero, to thee, and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra, of what moveth not!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
That we may win us wealth and power we poets, verily, call on thee: In war men call on thee, Indra, the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee:
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
To you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know; The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousandfold.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify This Indra, even your wondrous God who checks attack, who takes delight in precious juice.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Loud singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke With haste, that he may help, as the bard's cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
With Plenty for his true ally the active man will gain the spoil. Your Indra, much-invoked, I bend with song, as bends a wright his wheel of solid wood.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Drink, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught! Be, for our weal, our friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
For thou--come to the worshipper!--wilt find great wealth to make us rich. Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
Vasishtha will not overlook the lowliest one among you all Beside our Soma juice effused to-day let all the Maruts drink with eager haste!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
Glorify naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you! Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.10

No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore: No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised of all, resistless, daring, bold in might. 2 He without ligature, before making incision in the neck, Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who healeth the dissevered parts.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
A thousand and a hundred steeds are harnessed to thy golden car: Yoked by devotion, Indra, let the long-maned bays bring thee to drink the Soma juice!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Come hither, Indra, with bay steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock's plumes! Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass o'er them as o'er desert lands!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Thou as a God, O mightiest, verily blessest mortal man. O Maghavan, there is no comforter but thou: Indra, I speak my words to thee.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous Lord of power and might. Alone, the never-conquered guardian of mankind, thou smitest down resistless foes.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds, Indra, as warriors in the battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth! Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee, Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength gain wealth and give unfailing help.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool, Come to us quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Indra, with all thy saving helps assist us, Lord of power and might! For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, hero, finderout of wealth.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
O Indra, Lord of light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras, Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one, A pleasant hymn to Varuna who shelters us: sing ye a laud unto the Kings!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first. The Ribhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, slay the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts! that slays the Vritras best, Whereby the holy ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
O Indra, give us wisdom as a sire gives wisdom to his sons Guide us, O much-invoked, in this our way: may we still live and look upon the light!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
O Indra, turn us not away: be present with us at our feast For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
We compass these like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed. Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vritra-slayer, sit.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
All strength and valour that is found, Indra, in tribes of Nahushas, And all the splendid fame that the Five Tribes enjoy, bring, yea, all manly powers at once!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
Yea, verily thou art a Bull, our guardian, rushing like a bull: Thou, mighty one, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vritra-slayer, near at hand, Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who bath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned steeds.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your hero with high laud, to him the wise, To Indra glorious in his name, the mighty one, even as the hymn alloweth it!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
O Indra, give us for our weal a triple refuge, triply strong! Bestow a dwelling-place on our rich lords and me, and keep thy dart afar from these!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun enjoy from Indra all good things! When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
The godless mortal gaineth not this food, O thou whose life is long! But one who yokes the bright-hued horses, Etasas; then Indra yokes his tawny steeds.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Draw near unto our Indra who must be invoked in every fight! Come, thou most mighty Vritra-slayer, meet for praise, come to, libations and to hymns!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
Thine, Indra, is the lowest wealth, thou cherishest the midmost wealth, Thou ever rulest all the highest: in the fray for cattle none resisteth thee.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind. Haste, warrior, fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din! haste, holy songs have sounded forth!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
Here, verily, yesterday we let the thunder-wielder drink his fill. Bring him the juice poured forth in sacrifice to-day. Now range you by the glorious one!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
He who as sovran Lord of men moves with his chariots unrestrained, The Vritra-slayer, vanquisher of fighting hosts, pre-eminent, is praised in song.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid Help us, O Maghavan, let thy favour aid us thus; drive away foes and enemies!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home! armour of Soma-offerers! The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rishis' friend.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great! O most admired for greatness of thy majesty, God, by thy greatness thou art great!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
Indra! thy friend, when fair of form and rich in chariots, steeds, and kine, Hath ever vital power that gives him strength, and joins the company with radiant men.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine,-- No, not a hundred suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
Though, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and west ward, north and south, Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave champion urged by men to come.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
Indra whose wealth is in thyself, what mortal will attack this man? The strong will win the spoil on the decisive day through faith in thee, O Maghavan!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
First, Indra! Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help; good kinsman, with good kinsmen come!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10
Call to your aid the eternal one who shoots and none may shoot at him, Inciter, swift, victorious, best of charioteers, unconquered, Tugriya's strengthener!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Let none, no, not thy worshippers, delay thee far away from us Even from faraway come thou unto our feast, or listen if' already here!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
For Indra Soma-drinker, armed with thunder, press the Soma juice; Make ready your dressed meats: cause him to favour us! The giver blesses him who gives.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
We call upon that Indra who, most active, ever slays the foe With boundless spirit, Lord of heroes, manliest one, help thou and prosper us in fight!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Ye rich in strength, through your great power vouchsafe us blessings day and night! The offerings which we bring to you shall never fail gifts brought by us shall never fail.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Whenever mortal worshipper will sing a bounteous giver's praise, Let him with song inspired laud Varuna who supports the folk who follow varied rites.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Drink milk to Indra in the joy of Soma juice, Medhyatithi! To golden Indra ever close to his bay steeds, the thunder-armed, the golden one!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Both boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned listen to this prayer of ours, And mightiest Maghavar, with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
Not for an ample price dost thou, Stone-caster! give thyself away, Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is. Thou and my mother, O good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.10
4: These Soma juice mixt with curd have been expressed for Indra here: Come with thy bay steeds, Thunder-wielder, to our home, to drink them till they make thee glad!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
Indra, these Somas with their lauds have been prepared for thy delight. Drink of the pleasant juice and listen to our songs; lover of song, reward the hymn!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
I call on thee, Sabardugha, this day, inspirer of the psalm. Indra, the richly-yielding milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way None stays that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice? This is the fair-cheeked. God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
What time thou castest from his seat and punishest the riteless man, Strengthen for opulence, O Indra Maghavan, our plant desired by many a one!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Let Tvashtar, Brahmanaspati, Parjanya guard our heavenly word, Aditi with her sons, the brothers, guard for us the invincible, the saving word!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra, ne'er dost thou desert the worshipper: But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Best slayer of the Vritras, yoke thy bay steeds, Indra, far away Come with the high ones hither, Maghavan, to us, mighty, to, drink the Soma juice!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
O Thunderer, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday: So, Indra, listen here to him who offers lauds: come near unto, our dwelling-place!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Advancing, sending forth her rays, the daughter of the Sky is seen. The mighty one lays bare the darkness with her eye, the friendly Lady makes the light.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
These morning sacrifices call you, Asvins, at the break of day. For help have I invoked you rich in power and might: for, house by house, ye visit all.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Where are ye, Gods? What mortal man, O Asvins, glows with zeal for you, Urging you with the crushing stone and with the stalk of Soma thus or otherwise?
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
This sweetest Soma juice hath been expressed for you at morning rites. Asvins, drink this prepared ere yesterday and give treasures to him who offers it!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Let me not, still beseeching thee with might and sound of Soma drops, Anger at sacrifice a fierce wild creature! Who would not beseech the almighty one!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Adhvaryu, let the Soma flow, for Indra longs to drink thereof. He even now hath yoked his vigorous bay steeds: the Vritraslayer hath come nigh.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Bring thou all this unto the good, O Indra, to the old and young! For, Maghavan, thou art rich in treasures from of old, to be invoked in every fight.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
If I, O Indra, were the lord of riches ample as thine own, I would support the singer, God who scatterest wealth! and not abandon him to woe.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the mansions of the sky. The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. Thou hast waxed mighty over all.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
Pressed is the juice divine with milk commingled: thereto hath Indra ever been accustomed. We wake thee, Lord of bays, with sacrifices: mark this our laud in the wild joys of Soma!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
A home is made for thee to dwell in, Indra: O much-invoked one, with the men go thither! Thou, that thou mayest guard us and increase us, givest us wealth and joyest in the Somas.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
The well thou clavest, settest free the fountains, and gavest rest to floods that were obstructed. Thou, Indra, laying the great mountain open, slaying the Ddnava, didst loose the torrents.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
When we have pressed the juice we laud thee, Indra, most valorous! even about to win the booty. Bring us prosperity, and by thy great wisdom, under thine own protection, may we conquer!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Thy right hand have we grasped in ours, O Indra, longing, thou very Lord of wealth, for treasures. Because we know thee, hero, Lord of cattle: vouchsafe us mighty and resplendent riches!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Men call on Indra in the armed encounter that he may make the hymns they sing decisive. Hero in combat and in love of glory, give us a portion of the stall of cattle!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Like birds of beauteous wing the Priyamedhas, Rishis, imploring, have come nigh to Indra. Dispel the darkness and fill full our vision: deliver us as men whom snares entangle!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
They gaze on thee with longing in their spirit, as on a strongwinged bird that mounteth sky-ward; On thee with wings of gold, Varuna's envoy, the Bird that hasteneth to the home of Yama.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
First in the ancient time was Prayer engendered: Vena disclosed the bright ones from the summit, Laid bare this world's lowest and highest regions, womb of the existent and the non- existent.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
They have prepared and fashioned for this hero words never matched, most plentiful, most auspicious, For him the ancient, great, strong, energetic, the very mighty wielder of the thunder.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
The black drop sank in Ansumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it. Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted King laid down his weapons.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
Flying in terror from the snort of Vritra all deities who were thy friends forsook thee. So, Indra, with the Maruts be thy friendship: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
The old hath waked the young Moon from his slumber who runs his circling course with many round him. Behold the God's high wisdom in its greatness: he who died yesterday to-day is living.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival. The hidden pair, heaven and the earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
A friend we count thee, sharp-edged, thunder-wielder, Steer strong of body, overthrowing many. Thou, helping, causest pious tribes to conquer: Indra, I laud the, heavenly Vritra-slayer.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
Bring to the wise, the great, who waxeth mighty your offerings,. and make ready your devotion! Go forth to many tribes as man's controller!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best hero in this fight where spoil is gathered, Strong, listening to give us aid in battles, who slays the Vritras, wins and gathers riches!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
Prayers have been offered up-through love of glory: Vasishtha, honour Indra in the battle! He who with fame extends through all existence hears words which I, his faithful servant, utter.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
May the sweet Soma juices make him happy to cast his quoit that lies in depth of waters! Thou from the udder which o'er earth is fastened hast poured the milk into the kine and herbage.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9
This vigorous one whom deities commission, the conqueror of cars, the strong and mighty, Swift, fleet to battle, with uninjured fellies, even Tarkshya for our weal will we call hither.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Indra the rescuer, Indra the helper, hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra Maghavan accept our presents!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
Indra whose right hand wields the bolt we worship, driver of bay steeds seeking sundered courses. Shaking his beard with might he hath arisen, terrible with his weapons, with his bounty.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
The ever-slaying, bold and furious Indra, the bright bolt's Lord, the strong, the great, the boundless, Who slayeth Vritra and acquireth booty, giver of blessings, Maghavan the bounteous.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
The man who lies in wait and fights against us, deeming himself a giant or a hero,-- By battle or with strength destroy him, Indra! With thy help, manly-souled! may we be victors!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
He whom men call when striving with their foemen, or speeding onward in array of battle, Whom bards incite where heroes win the booty, or in the way to waters, He is Indra.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
On a high car, O Parvata and Indra, bring pleasant viands, with brave heroes, hither! Enjoy our presents, Gods, at sacrifices: wax strong by hymns, rejoice in our oblation!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
In ceaseless flow hath he poured forth his praises, as waters from the ocean's depth, to Indra, Who to his car on both its sides securely hath fixed the earth and heaven as with an axle.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
May our friends turn thee hitherward to friendship! Mayst thou approach us even o'er many rivers! May the Disposer, radiant in this mansion with special lustre, bring the father's offspring!
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
Who yokes to-day unto the pole of Order the strong and passionate steers of checkless spirit, Health-bringing, bearing in their mouths no fodder? Long shall he live who richly pays their service.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.10
The singers hymn thee, they who chant the psalm of praise are lauding thee. The Brahmans have exalted thee, O Satakratu, like a pole.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.1
All sacred-songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, Best of all warriors borne on cars, the Lord of heroes, Lord of strength.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
This poured libation, Indra, drink, immortal, gladdening, excellent: Streams of the bright have flowed to thee here at the seat of holy Law.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Stone-darting Indra, wondrous God, what wealth thou hast not given me here, That bounty, treasure-finder! bring, filling full both thy hands, to us!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
O Indra, hear Tiraschi's call, the call of him who serveth thee! Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring! Great art thou.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
This Soma hath been pressed for thee, O Indra: bold one, mightiest, come! May Indra-vigour fill thee full, as Surya fills mid-air with rays
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Come hither, Indra, with thy bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy! Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
Song-lover! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows. Together, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymn! Let milk-blent juice delight him made stronger with pure, pure songs of praise!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
That which, most wealthy, makes you rich, in splendours most illustrious, Soma is pressed: thy gladdening drink, Indra libation's Lord! is this.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Bring forth oblations to the God who knoweth all who fain would drink, The wanderer, lagging not behind the hero, coming nigh with speed!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
To us the mighty, lying in all vital power, who resteth in the deep, who standeth in the east. Drive thou the awful word away.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Even as a car to give us aid, we draw thee nigh to favour us, Strong in thy deeds, quelling attack, Indra, Lord, mightiest! of the brave.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
With powers of mighty ones hath he, the friend, the ancient, been equipped, Through whom our father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
What time the swift and shining steeds, yoked to the chariots, draw them on, Drinking the sweet delightful juice, there men perform their glorious acts.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Him for your sake I glorify as Lord of Strength who wrongeth none, Indra the hero, mightiest, all-conquering and omniscient.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
I with my praise have glorified strong Dadhikravan, conquering steed Sweet may he make our mouths: may he prolong the days we have to live!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
Render of forts, the young, the wise, of strength unmeasured, was he born, Sustainer of each sacred rite, Indra, the Thunderer, much-extolled.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Offer the triple sacred draught to Indu hero-worshipper! With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
Those whom they call the attendant pair of Kasyapa who knows the light, Lords of each holy duty when the wise have honoured sacrifice.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, men, Priya-medhas, sing your songs: Yea, let young children sing their lauds: yea, glorify our firm stronghold!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
To Indra must a laud be said, a joy to him who freely gives, That Sakra may be joyful in our friendship and the juice we pour.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Your Lord of might that ne'er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind, I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
Even he who is thine own, through thought of Heaven, of mortal man who toils, He with the help of lofty Dyaus comes safe through straits of enmity.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Wide, Indra Satakratu, spreads the bounty of thine ample grace: So, good and liberal giver, known to all men, send us splendid wealth!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
Bright Ushas, when thy times return, all quadrupeds and bipeds stir, And round about flock winged birds from all the boundaries of heaven.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Ye Gods who yonder have your home amid the luminous realm of heaven, What count ye right? what endless life? What is the ancient call on you?
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
We offer laud and psalm wherewith men celebrate their holy rites. They govern at the sacred place and bear the sacrifice to Gods.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.10

Heroes of one accord brought forth and formed for kingship Indra who wins the victory in all encounters, For power, in firmness, in the field, the great destroyer, fierce and exceeding strong,rstalwart and full of vigour.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1

I trust in thy first wrathful deed, O Indra, when thou slewest Vritra and didst work to profit man; When the two world-halves fled for refuge unto thee, and earth even trembled at thy strength, O Thunder-armed!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
Come all with might together to the Lord of heaven, the only one who is indeed the guestof men. He is the first: to him who fain would come to us all pathways turn; he is in truth the only one.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3

Thine, Indra, praised of many, excellently rich, are we who trusting in thy help draw near to thee. For none but thou, song-lover, shall receive our lauds: as Earth loves all her creatures, welcome this our hymn!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4

High hymns have sounded forth the praise of Maghavan, supporter of mankind, of Indra meet for lauds; Him who hath waxen mighty, much-invoked with prayers, immortal one whose praise each day is sung aloud.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5

In perfect unison have all your longing hymns that find the light of heaven sounded forth Indra's praise. As wives embrace their lord, the comely bridegroom, so they compass Maghavan about that he may help.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6

Make glad with songs that Ram whom many men invoke, worthy hymns of praise, Indra the sea of wealth; Whose boons spread like the heavens, the - lover of mankind: sing praise to him the Sage, most liberal for our good!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7

I glorify that Ram who finds the light of heaven, whose hundred strong and mighty ones go forth with him. With prayers may I turn hither Indra to mine aid;-the car which like a swift steed hasteth to the call!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8

Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The heaven and the earth by Varuna's decree, unwasting, rich in germs, stand parted each from each.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.9

As like the Morning, thou hast filled, O Indra, both the earth. and heaven, So as the mighty one, great King of all the mighty race of men, the Goddess mother brought thee forth, the blessed mother gave thee life.
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.10

Sing, with oblation, praise to him who maketh glad, who with. Rijisvan drove the dusky brood away! Let us, desiring help, call him for friendship, him the strong, the Marut-girt, whose right hand wields the bolt!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.11
Sing forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud: Invite the potent Indra with your songs of praise
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquer; in the fray, Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold,
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
Whether thou drink the Soma by Vishnu's or Trita Aptya's side, Or with the Maruts, Indra! quaff the following drops.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Come, priest, and of the savoury juice pour forth a yet more gladdening draught: So is the hero praised who ever prospers us.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
Pour out the drops for Indra; let him drink the meath of Soma juice! He through his majesty sends forth his bounteous gifts.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends! the hero who deserves the laud, Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Sing ye a psalm to Indra, sing a great song to the lofty Sage, To him who maketh prayer, inspired who loveth laud!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
He who alone bestoweth wealth on mortal man who offereth gifts Is Indra only, potent Lord whom none resist.
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
Companions, let us learn a prayer to Indra, to the Thunderer, To glorify your bold and most heroic friend!
Chapter II · Decade V · Hymn 5.10

For thee this Soma hath been pressed, in whose wild joy thou madest once Sambara Divodasa's prey: O Indra, drink!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable! Wide as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of heaven!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Joy, mightiest Indra, that perceives, sprung from deep Soma draughts, whereby Thou smitest down the greedy fiend,-that joy we crave!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Adityas, very mighty ones, grant to our children and our seed This lengthened term of life that they may live long days!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
Though knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed! how to avoid destructive powers, As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity: Adityas, keep us far removed from sore distress!
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
Drive Soma, Indra, Lord of bays! and let it cheer thee: the stone, like a well-guided courser,
Chapter I · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
Still, Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou: Thou seekest friendship but in war.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
Him who of old hath broucht to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you, Even Indra, O my friends, for help.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Fail not when marching onward: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away Ye who can tame even what is firm!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
Come hither to the dropping juice, O Lord of cornland. Lord of horses, Lord of kine: Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Hero, may we, with thee for friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath, In fight with people rich in kine!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
Yea, kin by common ancestry, the Maruts, even the oxen, close united friends! Are licking one another's back.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring A hero conquering in war!
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
So, Indra, friend of song, do we draw nigh to thee with longing; we have streamed to thee Coming like floods that follow floods
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, which gladdeneth and exalteth thee, Indra, to thee we sing aloud.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
We call on thee, O matchless one! We, seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves, Call on thee, wondrous, Thunder-armed.
Chapter I · Decade II · Hymn 2.10
The juice of Soma thus diffused, sweet to the taste the bright cows drink, Who travelling in splendour close to mighty Indra's side rejoice, good in their own supremacy.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.1
Thus hath the Soma, gladdening draught, produced the prayer that giveth joy: Thou, mightiest, Thunder-armed, hast driven by force the Dragon from the earth, lauding thine own supremacy.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.2
By men hath Indra been advanced, the Vritra-slayer, to joy and strength. Him only we invoke for help in battles whether great or small: be he our aid in deeds of might!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.3
Unconquered strength is only thine, Indra, Stonecaster, Thunder-armed! When thou with thy surpassing power smotest to death that guileful beast, lauding thine own supremacy.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.4
Go forward, meet the foe, be bold; thy bolt of thunder is not checked! Manliness, Indra, is thy strength. Slay Vritra, make the waters thine, lauding thine own supremacy!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.5
When war and battles are on foot, booty is offered to the bold. Yoke thou thy wildly-rushing bays. Whom wilt thou slay, and whom enrich? Do thou, O Indra, make us rich!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.6
Wcll have they eaten and rejoiced; the friends have risen and passed away: The sages luminous in themselves have praised thee with their latest hymn. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.7
Graciously listen to our songs. Maghavan, be not negligent! When wilt thou make us glorious? Make this, only this thine end and aim. Now, Indra! yoke thy two bay steeds.
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.8
Within the waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings in heaven. Ye lightnings with your golden wheels, men find not your abiding-place. Mark this my woe, ye Earth and Sky!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.9
To meet your treasure-bringing car, the mighty car most dear to us. Asvins, the Rishi is prepared, your worshipper, with songs of praise. Lovers of sweetness, hear my call!
Chapter I · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
O Agni, God, we kindle thee, refulgent, wasting not away, That this more glorious fuel may send forth for thee its shine to heaven. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.1
With offerings of our own we choose thee, Agni, as our Hotar priest, Piercing and brightly shining-at your glad carouse-served with trimmed grass at sacrifice. Thou waxest great.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
O heavenly Dawn, awaken us to ample opulence to-day, Even as thou didst waken us with Satyasravas, Vayya's son, high born! delightful with thy steeds!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Send us a mind that brings delight, send energy and mental power. Then-at your glad carouse-let men joy in thy love, sweet juice! as kine in pasturage. Thou waxest great,
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4
Great, as his nature is, through power, terrible, he hath waxed in strength, Lord of bay steeds, strong-jawed, sublime, he in joined hands for glory's sake hath grasped his iron thunderbolt.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
He, Indra, verily will mount the powerful car that finds the kine, Who thinks upon the well-filled bowl, the tawny coursers' harnesser. Now, Indra, yoke thy two bay steeds!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.6
I think of Agni who is kind, whom, as their home, the milch-kine seek: Whom fleet-foot coursers seek as home, and strong enduring steeds as home. Bring food to those who sing thy praise!
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.7
No peril, no severe distress, ye Gods, affects the mortal man Whom Aryaman and Mitra lead, and Varuna, of one accord, beyond his foes.
Chapter I · Decade IV · Hymn 4.8
Flow forth, O Soma, flow thou onward, sweet to Indra's Mitra's, Pushan's, Bhaga's taste.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.1
Run forth to battle, conquering the Vritras; thou speedest to quell the foes like one exacting debts.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.2
Flow onward, Soma, as a mighty sea, as Father of the Gods, to every form.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.3
Flow onward, Soma, flow for mighty strength, as a strong courser, bathed, to win the prize.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.4
Fair Indu hath flowed on for rapturous joy, sage, for good fortune, in the waters' lap.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.5
In thee, effused. O Soma, we rejoice ourselves for great supremacy in fight: Thou, Pavamana, enterest into mighty deeds.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.6
Who are these radiant men in serried rank, Rudra's young heroes, too, with noble steeds?
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.7
Agni, with hymns may we now accomplish that which thou lovest, Strength, like a horse, auspicious strength with service.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.8
The strong youths have come forth to view, to show their strength, God Savitar's quickening energy: Ye warrior horsemen, win the heavens.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.9
Soma, flow splendid with thy copious stream in due succession through the ample fleece.
Chapter I · Decade V · Hymn 5.10
Giver from all sides, bring to us from every side, thou whom as strongest we entreat!

This Brahman, comer at due time, named Indra, is renowned and praised.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.2
The Brahmans with their hymns exalting Indra increased his strength that he might slaughter Ahi.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.3
Anavas wrought a chariot for thy courser, and Tvashtar, much-invoked! the bolt that gitters:
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.4
Rest, wealth to him who longs for wealth! the riteless stirs not his love nor wins his way to riches.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.5
The cows are ever pure and all-supporting, the Gods are ever free from stain and blemish.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.6
With all thy beauty come! The kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.7
May we, inhabiting a meath-rich dwelling, increase our wealth, and think of thee, O Indra!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.8
The Maruts with fair hymns chant out their praise-song: this Indra, famed and youthful, shouts accordant.
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.9
Sing to your Indra, mightiest Vritra-slayer, sing to the Sage the song that he accepteth!
Chapter II · Decade I · Hymn 1.10
Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.1
O Agni, be our nearest friend, yea, our protector and our kind deliverer!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.2
Like wondrous Bhaga, Agni deals treasure among the mighty.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.3
Far off or present even now, send forth thy shouting first of all!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.4
Dawn drives away her sister's gloom, and through her excellence makes her retrace her path.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.5
May we, with Indra and the Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds to full completion!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.6
Like streams of water on their way, let bounties, Indra, flow from thee!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.7
With this may we obtain strength god-appointed, happy with brave sons through a hundred winters!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.8
With strength let Mitra, Varuna swell oblations; do thou prepare for us rich food, O Indra!
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.9
Indra is King of all the world.
Chapter II · Decade II · Hymn 2.10

At the Trikadrukas the great and strong enjoyed the barley-brew. With Vishnu did he drink the pressed-out Soma juice, even as he would. That hath so heightened him the great, the wide to do his mighty work. So did the God attend the God, true Indu Indra who is true.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.1

This God who sees for thousands of mankind, the light, the thought of poets, and the Law, The brilliant one, hath sent forth hither all the Dawns: spotless, one-minded, zealous in their home they dwell, with thought upon the Steer.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.2

Come to us, Indra, from afar, conducting us, as, to the gatherings, a Lord of heroes, as an archer King, the heroes' Lord! We come with gifts of pleasant food, with flowing juice, invoking thee, as sons invite a sire, that we may win the spoil, thee, bounteousest, for gain of spoil.
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.3

Loudly I call that Indra Maghavan, the mighty, resistless, evermore possessing many glories. Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, through songs, and, thunder-armed make all our pathways pleasant!
Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.4

Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.5

To Vishnu, to the mighty whom the Maruts follow, let your hymns born in song go forth, Evayamarut! To the strong, very holy band adorned with bracelets, that rushes on in joy and ever roars for vigour!

Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.7

I praise this God, parent of heaven and earth, exceeding wise, possessed of real energy, giver of treasure, thinker dear to all, Whose splendour is sublime, whose light shone brilliant in, creation, who, wise and golden-handed, in his beauty mader the sky.

Chapter II · Decade III · Hymn 3.10
High is thy juice's birth: though set it heaven, on earth it hath obtained dread sheltering power and great renown.

In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, pressed out for Indra, for his drink!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.2
Flow onward mighty with thy stream, inspiriting the Maruts' Lord, winning all riches with thy power!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.3
Flow onward with that juice of thine most excellent, that brings delight, slaying the wicked, dear to Gods!
Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.4

Chapter II · Decade IV · Hymn 4.5
